'''Uloitir Sea''' was an area of [[Water/Legends|water]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Pirik]]. It was fourteen [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the planetary [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Corint City]].
